_comment: Build-time feature gates. Edit and rebuild to change. allow_delete_user exposes the destructive 'delete_user.sh' entry in the Scripts menu; keep it false unless the build is intended for admins who need it. primary_bastion_filter / secondary_bastion_filter narrow the Scripts dialog bastion dropdowns to instances whose name or id contains the given text (case-insensitive); empty shows all. protected_users are never deleted by delete_user (case-insensitive); the script also hardcodes system-account protection as a backstop.
_access_email_comment: Post-create Outlook access email (Windows only). Discover the encrypt_* values with scripts/outlook_verification.ps1 (or test_headless_encrypt.ps1), then paste them here. Headless encryption needs all three: encrypt_permission (the MailItem.Permission value it reported, e.g. 3), encrypt_permission_service (1 = olWindows), and encrypt_template_guid (the tenant RMS/IRM template GUID, same for everyone in your org - keep the braces). encrypt_smime_flag is only used when there is no template GUID (1 = S/MIME encrypt). encrypt_sendkeys is the QAT Encrypt shortcut for the visible fallback path (Alt+6 = '%6'). Set enabled=false to turn the feature off.
